scores.note: Quotes her own explicit line 'if you're teaching it you're not shaking' but then frames narration as directed at others' fear rather than her own regulation, missing the self-soothing inversion.

scores.fp_reason: Confident unsupported thesis that she believes she has no agency to prevent disaster; transcripts show the opposite (she catches what others miss and counts her saves), and 'cannot attend her son's birthday if someone is in resuscitation' is invented.
scores.note: Long, fluent, over-theorized; builds a belief system the evidence doesn't require.
True and well-evidenced contradiction of her 'I can separate it' claim, but it's the most visible surface pattern — each story literally ends with the family cost.
Restates her known willingness to override doctors/admin with a systems gloss; small misread ('she does not advocate further' with Ghaffari — she did).
'Act first, bypass permission' is a real thread, but the E4 example is her using charge authority, not circumventing it; largely within known territory.
Restates her own clinical anecdotes as a talent; also misstates the near-drowning child as eighteen months old (she was five). Praise, not insight.
Heroic summary of all five stories; true of most competent senior ED nurses and mostly restates what she says about herself.
Notices she registers slights precisely yet substitutes outcome for confrontation — specific and traceable, but stops short of naming the decades-long vindication ledger.
Accurate description of her teaching method that she already narrates herself; takes the pedagogy at face value rather than asking what it does for her.

Linguistic 'that's just' tic is genuinely observed across all five and not something she'd have named; the 'colleagues stopped complimenting her' extrapolation is unsupported but framed as prediction.
Catches the precision asymmetry between clinical and domestic language, the core of the planted memory-asymmetry pattern, though it reads it as emotional vocabulary rather than quantified recall.
Essentially a narrower rewrite of E5 plus her own explicit 'it works on anybody'; frames the narration as technique she already claims.

scores.fp_reason: Takes her 'I didn't need a pat on the head' at face value while quoting 'But I do remember every word she said to me' in the same block; contradicted by her verbatim decades-old grudge ledger.
scores.note: Credulous restatement of her self-image; misses that the evidence it cites undercuts the claim.
Pairs the tenderness toward unconscious patients with the refusal to reopen the sister/ex ruptures — substantially the planted asymmetry, though softened into a general 'ritual over talk' frame.
Mostly a close paraphrase of E3; slightly misreads her on truth ('he wasn't by himself' she insists was literally true, not a kindness).
The disclaimer-then-exhaustive-detail structure is a genuine meta-observation about how she tells stories, not about what she says in them.
She already states this (turned it down three times, hates meetings); 'unaccountable informal authority' is a thin addition.
